**Date:** Tuesday 10 November 2026  
**Time:** 14:00 - 15:30  
**Venue:** QT Perth, Murray Room

## Summary

The Industry, Government and Growers session brings together perspectives from across the Australian grains sector. Presentations will be followed by a panel Q&amp;A, creating an opportunity to discuss priorities, challenges and opportunities for collaboration.
